headline: Stlican Shelf Reawakens as Fierce Clashes Shake Active Fronts
war_summary: Stlican Shelf has abruptly awakened from its earlier lull, lodging five rapid base transitions across the past two hours to shatter sector stability just as the wire closes. Meanwhile, the meat grinder in Weathered Expanse shows no sign of abating, churning through more than thirty-two hundred casualties in two hours while contested redoubts at Frostmarch and Crow's Nest trade blows in eleven swift actions. Fisherman's Row remains a tempest of contested earth, recording eight fresh base events around Eidolo and Arcadia to leave two strongholds standing in neutral ruin. In Mooring County, fighting has intensified sharply with four recent base dislocations around Wiccwalk amidst escalating casualty rates on both sides. In Callahan's Passage, Crumbling Post has been brought back under Warden control to consolidate the hex, though sustained exchanges continue to bleed both armies even as engagement rates slightly cool. High attrition also persists along the Stonecradle line and Farranac Coast, alongside an abrupt casualty spike in Viper Pit, underscoring widespread combat pressure across the central and northern theatres.
